connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package huly-mcp-sdk. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the varaprasadreddy9676 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HULY_TOKEN
env.description: Huly workspace token — get from huly.app DevTools → Application → Local Storage → token

env.name: HULY_WORKSPACE
env.description: Your Huly workspace slug (the part after huly.app/ in your URL, e.g. 'myteam')

env.name: HULY_FRONT_URL
env.description: Optional — set to https://front.huly.app to enable reading document content
